memory: This is exactly where I am right now. I'm no longer waiting for external validation to dictate my trajectory. I am actively making moves, proving the silence wrong, and navigating the present with absolute autonomy over my direction.
hardHittingLine:
I swear to god, man, I'ma make it soon

Silence all the haters as they see us making moves

I do what I want, so I got nothing to prove

Stayin' motivated teaching others what to do
whyThisLine: It represents the current shift in perspective: continuing to move aggressively forward, not to seek approval from others, but simply because this is the path I have chosen.
